camel_example: aliyun ice SetContentAnalyzeConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Auto true --SaveType 'TEXT,FACE' --TemplateId 'S00000101-100070' --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Calls SetContentAnalyzeConfig to set the configuration for intelligent content analysis
description_zh: 调用SetContentAnalyzeConfig 设置智能内容分析的配置
kebab_example: aliyun ice set-content-analyze-config --auto true --save-type TEXT,FACE --template-id S00000101-100070 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetContentAnalyzeConfig

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically initiate intelligent content analysis after media asset registration is complete.

Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
媒资注册完成后是否自动发起智能内容分析。

取值：
true：开启
false：不开启，默认为false
parameters.name: auto

parameters.help_en:
The type of library to which analysis results are saved. This parameter can be configured only when Auto is set to true. Default value: empty.
TEXT: label
FACE: face
DNA: similar image

Multiple values are supported. Separate multiple values with commas (,). If this field is empty, the results of intelligent content analysis are not saved to any search library by default, and no content search of any form can be performed subsequently
parameters.help_zh:
分析结果入库类型，仅当Auto = true 时可配置。默认值为空。
TEXT: 标签
FACE：人脸
DNA：相似图

支持多值，多值以半角逗号（,）分隔。如果此字段为空，智能内容分析的结果默认不入任何搜索库，后续也无法进行任何形式的内容搜索
parameters.name: save_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the intelligent content analysis template. Each template includes the following AI analysis features:
S00000101-100040: optical character recognition (OCR)
S00000101-100060: video classification + face recognition
S00000101-100070: OCR + video classification + face recognition
parameters.help_zh:
智能内容分析模板ID。各模板包含以下AI分析功能：
S00000101-100040 : 文字识别
S00000101-100060 : 视频分类+人脸识别
S00000101-100070 : 文字识别+视频分类+人脸识别
parameters.name: template_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the configuration is set successfully. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
是否设置成功。取值：
true： 成功
false：失败
